integrity: Analytical proof of full rational-parameter statement; finite exact-combinatorial checks and high-precision sample inversions are supplementary, not substitutes for proof. Publication priority is assessed against inspected materials and is not independently certified.
scientific_limitations: The criterion uses the already established rational contracted-rotation tongue formula. The contribution consists of its unique fixed-translation inversion and sharp two-edge asymptotics. All asymptotics are for fixed reduced p/q; no irrational, high-denominator uniform or attractor-selection statement is made.
title: Fixed-translation resonance intervals and two-edge scaling for contracted rotations
